content_blocks.title: Apply the idea
content_blocks.text: Solve the question with a small subquery or named query result, then compare its output with a second formulation. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code: WITH RECURSIVE sequence_nums (n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM sequence_nums WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM sequence_nums ORDER BY n;
content_blocks.expected_output: Five rows: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The recursive member has an explicit stop condition.
